accuracy_cost: Scatter of test mAP@0.5:0.95 against estimated engine latency per frame. Fixed FP16 26.71 pts at 2.70 ms; Fixed INT8 25.76 pts at 1.99 ms; Adaptive (locked) 25.81 pts at 2.02 ms; Matched random 25.77 pts at 2.02 ms; i.i.d. random 26.16 pts at 2.34 ms; Oracle (uses GT) 26.67 pts at 2.25 ms; Fixed FP32 26.70 pts at 7.78 ms. Grey crosses are 18 ablation and delta-locked controllers, all clustered near fixed INT8. Engine-only latency; the adaptive controller's cue cost is excluded here and reported separately.
measured_latency_energy: Two bar charts measured live on one Tesla T4. (a) median latency per frame: FP32 11.02 ms, FP16 5.78 ms, INT8 5.03 ms, Adapt. seq. 8.85 ms, Adapt. pipe. 5.54 ms.
